# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/lab
# args: 
lab: A GitLab Command Line Interface Utility

Usage:
  lab [flags]
  lab [command]

Available Commands:
  ci            Work with GitLab CI pipelines and jobs
  clone         GitLab aware clone repo command
  completion    Generates autocompletion for different shell implementations
  fork          Fork a remote repository on GitLab and add as remote
  help          Show the help for lab
  issue         Describe, list, and create issues
  label         List and search labels
  milestone     List and search milestones
  mr            Describe, list, and create merge requests
  project       Perform project level operations on GitLab
  snippet       Create a personal or project snippet
  todo          Check out the todo list for MR or issues
  version       

Flags:
      --debug      Enable debug logging level
  -h, --help       help for lab
      --no-pager   Do not pipe output into a pager
      --quiet      Turn off any sort of logging. Only command output is printed
      --version    Show the lab version

Use "lab [command] --help" for more information about a command.
